name: bq-gambling-tax
description: Analyse 2026 gambling tax in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. Use for licensed operators, lotteries, other domestic prizes and foreign prizes of BES residents or entities. Separates operator margins, prize bases, withholding and self-assessment, including exemptions, aggregation, loss carry, gross-up and reporting periods. Includes primary legislation, implementing rules, current authority guidance and fictional boundary calculations. This source-cited draft holds actual licensing, delegated register details, wider tax-borne arrangements, form mapping and unresolved operational cases. Load with the universal workflow base and applicable BES companions; professional review remains required before reliance.
